_source.text: MURTY, Phillip (17, bootmaker), CHAPMAN, Patrick (16, printer), and ALLEN, Thomas (15, stickmaker) , were charged on the coroners inquisition with the wilful murder of Garrett William Dundon. Mr. Muir, for the prosecution, said the prisoner's were all brought up before the magistrate charged with wilful murder. The magistrate discharged them on that charge, and with his lordship's permission he proposed to offer no evidence. A verdict of Not guilty was entered. (Thursday, May 30.)
